primaryAction: Define one primary action and its success state.

referenceFidelity.claimBoundary: Use reference-close only for an approved, hash-bound, user-owned, licensed, or authorized source.

assetBoundaries.isolatedObjectRule: Generate only the named subject as a transparent PNG; do not bake in sky, scene, page background, copy, or UI.
assetBoundaries.identityArtworkRule: Generate identity lines, dividers, contours, and ornaments as transparent raster assets.
assetBoundaries.functionalGeometryRule: Reserve CSS for explicitly functional interface geometry.
assetBoundaries.directionFrameRule: Never crop a production asset from a full-page direction frame.
